context: A barista asks a friend for help redecorating the cafe interior
purpose: Teach: 小売/通販/入社/デバイス/インテリア/店内/応答/受け取っ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ねえ、店内の雰囲気を一新したくて、インテリアの相談に乗ってほしいんだ。
lines.en: Hey, I want to refresh the cafe's atmosphere, so I'd love your help with the interior.
lines.style: Warm friendly tone with a slightly hesitant request leaning forward

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん協力するよ。実は先月、新しい雑貨の通販サイトを見つけたばかりなの。
lines.en: Of course I'll help. Actually, I just found a new homewares mail-order site last month.
lines.style: Soft excited voice with a gentle dreamy lilt curling upward

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ほんと？うちは小売の家具屋を回っても、ピンとくる物が全然なくてさ。
lines.en: Really? I've been around retail furniture stores but nothing has clicked at all.
lines.style: Slightly tired sigh blending into hopeful upward inflection at end

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日サンプルを受け取ったんだけど、木の質感がすごく優しいの。きっと気に入るよ。
lines.en: I got a sample yesterday, and the wood texture is so gentle. You'll love it.
lines.style: Soft melodic delivery with affectionate emphasis on sensory words

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 見てみたい！照明とかも変えて、カウンターの真ん中に小さなデバイスでBGMを流したいんだ。
lines.en: I want to see it! I'm also changing the lighting and adding a small device for background music.
lines.style: Bright animated rhythm with rising enthusiasm and quick playful pacing

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: いいね。注文フォームに応答が来るまで一日くらいかかるから、早めに連絡しておこう。
lines.en: Nice. It takes about a day to get a response to the order form, so let's contact them early.
lines.style: Calm thoughtful pace with warm advisory tone almost whispering tips

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 助かる！うちの新入社員にもセンスを聞いて、みんなで楽しい空間を作りたいな。
lines.en: That helps! I want to ask my new hire's taste too and make a fun space together.
lines.style: Genuine grateful warmth with collaborative cheerful energy and soft laugh
